author: Donna Ridge Ingle
text: The hospital told me that if I had to go to the hospital they would not honor my sensor, nor would I be able to take my current med, Rybelsus, since it was not on their formulary.  I would have to endure the endless fingersticks and they would administer insulin via my belly if needed.  Another reason for me to stay healthy and not have to go to the hospital!!
